answer: The fable counter is kept in tundra and wander shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 50 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A hostile operator therefore has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 50 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Scaling to 308 identities multiplies that fee by 119 with no matching gain in influence. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
